name_en: Chen Pi Bai Cha (White Tea in Tangerine)
aliases: Shou Mei with Aged Tangerine Peel Dragon Balls
Three Treasure white tea in tangerine

brewing.notes: A safe starting point for white tea: use hot but not boiling water and give it time.

description:
White tea, often Shou Mei, combined with aged tangerine peel, either packed in the fruit or rolled into balls.

Recipes for a flavoured or scented tea vary from one maker to the next, so read the ingredient list and brew it like its base tea.
processing: A white base tea flavoured or scented by the maker; the recipe varies.
harvest_season: The base tea can come from any picking, so the season matters less than the recipe.
appearance_dry: Usually downy buds or soft, silvery-green leaves.
appearance_liquor: Usually a pale straw to light amber.
appearance_wet: Usually soft, intact leaf and bud.
taste_profile: Expect what white teas usually give: gentle, sweet and lightly floral.
vintage_note: Flavoured and scented teas are not sold by vintage. Buy recent stock and drink it within a year or so, since the aroma fades.
